name: BK72xx Bluetooth Low Energy
description: The `bk72xx_ble` component enables the Bluetooth Low Energy controller of the BLE-5.x LibreTiny Beken chips (`beken-72xx` family) — the platform analog of [ESP32 BLE](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble/). It owns the BLE stack bring-up and the controller's BLE address; higher-level consumers (such as the BK72xx BLE tracker) build on it and load it automatically.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used to reference this component.

config_entries.label: Enable On Boot
config_entries.description: Bring the BLE stack up during boot. Defaults to `false`: on the single-core BK72xx, stack init during boot competes with the WiFi connection handshake, so consumers enable the stack lazily on first use instead.
